plugin.name: QueueConsume
plugin.title: Queue Consume
plugin.desc: Removes each track from the play queue once it has finished playing or has been skipped. After installing the plugin, enable in the Player WebUI -> Extra Settings.
plugin.creator: Elon Brisola

plugin.name: DSDTranscode
plugin.title: DSD Transcode
plugin.desc: On-the-fly transcoding of DSD files compressed in WavPack to PCM, enabling use of software volume control. After installing the plugin, enable in the Player WebUI -> Extra Settings.
plugin.creator: Elon Brisola
